title: Exact-Rational Sublinear-Degree Pauli Approximation, Fourier Weight Ceilings, and Quantum Advice Separation Certificates for AC0 vs BQAC0/qpoly
abstract: Motivated by Xiaoming Sun and Jingheng Wang's proof of AC0 not subseteq BQAC0/qpoly via sublinear-degree Pauli approximation (arXiv:2611.34803v1, Nov. 2026), we construct a machine-checked, zero-float verification and certificate suite (PAULI-AC0-BQAC0-CERT-1.0) backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, -DwarningAsError=true), an AST-audited exact-Q verifier, 16 SHA-256 certificates (C01-C16), and 62 adversarial tests. We certify: (i) super-exponential collapse of the sublinear-degree Pauli subspace fraction sum_{k<=d} C(n,k)3^k / 4^n from 67/256 (n=4, d<=2) to 163669/4^16 approx 3.81e-5 (n=16, d<=4); (ii) exhaustive symplectic verification of Z-group Pauli twirling on n=2 (16 Paulis) and n=3 (64 Paulis), proving exact diagonal projection onto 2^n I/Z operators and strict Frobenius contraction; (iii) exact closed-form Boolean Fourier spectra and Parseval checks for P-uniform linear-size monotone depth-2 CNFs, quantifying exact operator-norm lower bounds via degree-d variance tails (35.60% lost above d=2 at n=18; 26.98% lost above d=3 at n=44); (iv) zero-float Taylor-certified stretched-exponential ceilings for state 2-design indistinguishability (exp(-225^(1/2))<3.10e-7, exp(-625^(1/2))<10^-10) and Anshu-Breuckmann-Nirkhe NLTS low-energy spectral weight (2*exp(-64^(2/3))<2.27e-7); and (v) exact operator-norm advantage-ceiling transfer.
